title: First variation formula (Simon 2.5.3) and second variation formula (Simon 2.5.4, C³ correction)
statement: Let M be an n-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold of ℝ^{n+ℓ}, U open with U ∩ M ≠ ∅ and Hⁿ(K′ ∩ M) < ∞ for compact K′ ⊆ U, and φ an admissible deformation (IsAdmissibleDeformation r U K φ) with initial velocity X and acceleration Z. (5.3) If r = 2, t ↦ Hⁿ(φ_t(M ∩ K)) has derivative ∫_M div_M X dHⁿ at t = 0. (5.4) If r = 3, this function is differentiable near 0 and its derivative has derivative ∫_M (div_M Z + (div_M X)² + Σ_i|(D_{τ_i}X)^⊥|² − Σ_{i,j}(τ_i·D_{τ_j}X)(τ_j·D_{τ_i}X)) dHⁿ at 0.
